**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree and seven (7) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.
  
  
Job Profile Summary:
  
Designs, develops, and troubleshoots complex software and applications in support of establishing a sustainable institutional technological infrastructure. This individual also conducts non-routine system analysis, contributes to strategy development, and may provide training.

**Job Description:**

As the Most Innovative University 12 years running and one of the largest, most inclusive public institutions in the country, Arizona State University commits to driving forward the most dynamic and productive learning experience in all of higher education. To realize that vision, ASU Enterprise Technology (ET) develops software and systems driven by the student experience, building quality at scale and driving innovation across the University.

  

This is an AI-first engineering role. The Staff Backend/DevOps Engineer sets technical direction for secure, reliable services and the infrastructure they run on, utilizing AI coding and operations agents as the primary mode of delivery: directing, reviewing, and verifying agent-generated code rather than primarily hand-writing it, while owning the correctness, security, data integrity, and operational reliability of systems that span multiple teams. Increasingly, they orchestrate multiple AI agents in parallel, build the agent setup that builds and operates those systems, and define how teams across the organization adopt multi-agent orchestration safely. The core skills become judgment about what good looks like for the systems and people that depend on the org
